// why: Bun applies the nearest tsconfig's `paths` when resolving imports; without this file the root tsconfig would map `gridla` to packages/gridla/src instead of the installed tarball. No `paths` here on purpose: a directory mapping for `react` would make Bun load preact's CommonJS build next to the ESM one and split preact into two instances. At runtime `react` resolves through the package.json alias to @preact/compat. Type-checking uses tsconfig.typecheck.json.
